scripts.build: npx tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/tailwind.css -o ./assets/css/main.css && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.serve: npx tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/tailwind.css -o ./assets/css/main.css && npx tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/tailwind.css -o ./assets/css/main.css --watch & bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload
scripts.serve_d: npx tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/tailwind.css -o ./assets/css/main.css && npx tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/tailwind.css -o ./assets/css/main.css --watch & bundle exec jekyll serve --drafts --livereload
